messages:
Nadia: Hi all  starting today! Quick questions on security onboarding: Ill be remote and ops said a laptop ships tomorrow, but can I use my personal Mac for the first 48hrs? Also what exactly does the MDM collect on personal devices? And when is the phishing sim scheduled?

Rafael: Welcome Nadia 44b You can use personal for a short time but must enroll in MDM (Intune) and enable FileVault and a strong passcode. MDM only reports device compliance state, OS version, and hostname it does not upload personal files. If you'd rather avoid enrolling, we can expedite a loaner for you. Phishsim is monthly  next one is 2026-04-10 09:00 PT.

Mina: Quick checklist for Mac if you enroll: 1) Install Company Portal app 2) Sign in with SSO 3) Accept profile 4) Confirm FileVault on (Terminal: ```fdesetup status```) 5) Set up screen lock + TouchID. If you run into DEP/ABM prompts let us know.

Nadia: Thanks. Two small concerns: 1) does MDM let admins see which apps I have installed? 2) will enrolling require a factory reset or change my apple id?

Rafael: Good Qs  MDM does not list personal app names by default; we only see compliance attributes. It will not force a factory reset or touch your Apple ID. The Company Portal may require installing a management profile but thats all. Any policy that requires more intrusive controls would be opt-in and wed notify you.

IT-ops: FYI @Nadia we shipped a laptop today (tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784). Expect delivery tomorrow. If you still want to enroll personal device for today, we can walk you through.

Nadia: Awesome, thanks! If I do enroll now will Slack/Drive stop working until approval? I need access to a few docs for my first-day tasks.

Mina: Slack and GDrive SSO generally works immediately. Some internal apps (secrets, payroll, admin portals) check device compliance and might be blocked until MDM shows compliant + encryption enabled. If anything is blocked DM me and Ill add a temporary exception for the first 24h.

secops-bot: Reminder: New hires must complete "Security Foundations" training within 7 days. Next phishing simulation: 2026-04-10 09:00 PT.

Nadia: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll enroll later today after lunch and ping here if I hit errors. Appreciate the quick help! :smile:
